openGaps.reason: The official CAS IPT archive verifies 17 exact collection-qualified Laguna de Bay source items; all 17 have supported source-name crosswalks and are admitted only as historical source-locality evidence in the research ledger. One unique MZUSP source item is matched by collection, catalog number and occurrence ID. Its two source-linked copies disagree on rank metadata: one says Espécie and one omits rank, while both portal interpretations resolve to family Ariidae. Its Laguna de Bay locality text is present, but the portal reports no geospatial location and the record has no waterBody field. The source reports CC BY-NC while GBIF reports CC BY, so the item remains held from public app projections pending provider-specific reuse clarification. This batch does not establish current presence or a complete lake checklist.
openGaps.nextAction: Obtain authoritative source-level clarification from MZUSP on provider-level reuse terms before public use; preserve source rank differences and the Laguna de Bay locality string as text-only evidence with no point or waterbody assignment.

openGaps.reason: Fourteen corrected GBIF candidates group into ten museum catalog identities. Direct Field Museum and CAS archives confirm two FMNH and six CAS SU(ICH) records with Balayan Bay locality text; the eight are admitted only as dated historical research-ledger evidence, with source date precision and all GBIF flags preserved. The CAS archive publishes its selected rows under CC0, and source catalog 28340 plus GBIF spelling variants resolve nomenclaturally to Planiliza macrolepis. A direct UMMZ Fish archive release 1.115 check confirms catalog 100346, Sillago sihama and Balayan Bay locality under CC BY 4.0, but the event date is blank; it remains an undated research-only locality candidate. Five GBIF citations resolve to one dated NMNH USNM 122919 item; dataset and row reuse are CC0. The direct NMNH record gives D 5115 OR D 5116; a 1910 station table places both in a Balayan Bay/Verde Island Passage area, while a 2015 specimen paper reports 623 m off northeastern Mindoro, consistent with D 5115 but not naming it. Keep the one item held from a Balayan Bay-only assertion because exact station and exclusive waterbody scope remain unresolved. Eight candidates have dated historical locality evidence, one undated locality candidate, and five duplicate citation rows remain held as one item. No current-presence or complete-checklist claim is made.
openGaps.nextAction: Rights are no longer the blocker for USNM 122919: CC0 is verified at the NMNH dataset and GBIF-row levels. Keep the five citations grouped as one item and held from a Balayan Bay-only assertion until station D 5115 versus D 5116 and the conflicting broad locality wording are reconciled; if a combined Balayan Bay/Verde Island Passage area is modeled, preserve it as a distinct combined scope. Keep coordinates, map points and current-presence claims out of the app.
